title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind - A Princess Who Loves Insects (Chrono Trigger Mix)
description:
The song that inspired Chrono Trigger's Corridors of time, ported in the style of Corridors of time. Very mystic, atmospheric, contemplative. I invite you to listen to the original versions by Joe Hisaishi. Useful for ruins, deserts and cave overworlds.

Trivia:

After humming corridors of time all the time, I did have my epiphany, found the similarity between the two, and decided to go for it.
This took a good bunch of hours trying to re-create melody from ear.
In the mix I added some elements from Corridors of Time, and also some elements from "Ohmu", the track from the image album. Below are the sources:
- Original soundtrack's "A princess who loves insects", starts at 1:00
- Image album's track "Ohmu", used as inspiration for the pitch bends.
- Re-mastered version
